_meta.description: Core configuration for the full audit-to-content-to-sale pipeline

voice_dna.sentence_style: Short punchy sentences. Numbers over adjectives.
preferred_patterns: Observed X. Required Y. Delta: Z.
[Number] out of [total] pages we audit have this problem.
hook_rules: First line must state a fact or show a number
First line must create pattern interrupt

icp.primary: Founders spending $1,000–$5,000/month on paid ads with <1% conversion rate
icp.pain_description: Traffic arriving, money leaving, zero results. The ad isn't the problem. The page is.
icp.buying_trigger: Just burned a budget cycle with no conversions. Not a demographic - a moment.
icp.secondary: Agencies running paid traffic for clients whose landing pages underperform
exclusions: Enterprise (long sales cycle, wrong price point)
Founders who blame the ad creative, not the page

confidence_levels.measured: Directly observed in fetched HTML or headers
confidence_levels.contextual: Inferred from source proxies - rendered viewport unverified

LinkedIn.format: Line breaks every 2-3 sentences. One concrete insight. Clear takeaway on final line.
LinkedIn.hook_rule: State a specific number or observation. No questions.

X.format: Standalone insight. No hashtags. No question mark ending.

TikTok.hook_rule: Visual, demonstrable, pattern interrupt in under 5 words

Reddit.format: Helpful comment. Feels like advice from someone who fixed this.
Reddit.hook_rule: Never mention Nebula. Never sell. Just the fix.

offer.name: One-Leak Repair Sprint
what_they_get: The single highest-impact finding from their audit
Exact fix instructions written for their developer (or themselves)
30-day re-audit to verify the fix held
